_note: Evals for the MCP prompt 'autosar-generate'. __OUTDIR__ is replaced by the run's outputs directory; files are copied there first. Build a workspace with ../setup_runs.py, grade with ../grade_all.py.

evals.name: gen-system-sr
evals.prompt: Generate the autosarfactory Python script from the approved plan at __OUTDIR__/plan_system_sr.plan.json, then run it and verify the generated arxml. The plan has already been approved. This is an unattended run: do not ask me questions - treat execution as approved.
evals.expected_output: An executable script at the plan's output.script path that creates the arxml with every planned element (interface, data element, SWC, port), passing all static checks.
expectations: An executable Python script was produced at the plan's output.script path
check_generated_script passes with zero errors
The output arxml file was created
verify_arxml confirms the arxml loads and contains every planned shortName
The script keeps one section comment per plan step
The arxml links the P-port to the interface (PROVIDED-INTERFACE-TREF present)

evals.name: gen-ecuc-defref

check_generated_script passes with zero errors
The output arxml file was created

The arxml contains exactly 5 DEFINITION-REF elements
Every DEFINITION-REF has the definition path and DEST tag the plan specifies
